question: For each academic term, give the term description and the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of all subjects offered during that term, considering only terms where at least one subject is offered in the fall term, the term is not cancelled, and the subjects are from the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS RANGE,
  VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS VARIANCE,
  STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
  AND t.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR <> 'C'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED f
    WHERE f.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
      AND f.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
  )
GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION

inner_cte2 AS c ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.avg_total_units, icte.total_units_variance, icte.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mfs.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, mfs.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mfs.num_subjects, mfs.TERM_START_DATE, mfs.TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_variance, NULL AS total_units_stddev, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'MathFallSubjects' AS Reason FROM MathFallSubjects AS mfs UNION ALL SELECT dus.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_subjects, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, dus.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev, dus.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnitsStats AS dus) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_subjects, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, total_units_variance, total_units_stddev, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason, SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte_math AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), avg_cip_math AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE AS FLOAT)) AS avg_cip FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), math_courses_filtered AS (SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte_math AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cip_math AS a WHERE i.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > a.avg_cip), inner_cte_units AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), units_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.total_units_variance, inner_cte.total_units_stddev, (inner_cte.avg_total_units - overall.avg_all_departments) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte_units AS inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_all_departments FROM (SELECT AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs) AS overall) SELECT mcf.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.SCHOOL_NAME, mcf.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.avg_total_units, us.total_units_variance, us.total_units_stddev, us.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM math_courses_filtered AS mcf JOIN units_stats AS us ON mcf.DEPARTMENT_NAME = us.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY mcf.admin_dept_dense_rank, us.total_units_variance DESC

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance, STDDEV(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT ccso.COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE IS NULL THEN ic.SUBJECT_CODE END) AS comm_intensive_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY comm_intensive_subject_count DESC) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.avg_total_units, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.comm_intensive_subject_count FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column

WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS c JOIN MathTermStats AS m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(dept) OVER (ORDER BY dept_sort, grade_type) = dept THEN NULL ELSE dept END AS department, grade_type, subject_count, min_total_units, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, sd.DLC_KEY AS dlc_key FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, GRADE_TYPE AS grade_type, COUNT(SUBJECT_COUNT) AS subject_count, MIN(min_total_units) AS min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev, o.DLC_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte2.area_stddev, o2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = o2.DLC_KEY) SELECT cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte1.subject_count, cte1.min_total_units, cte1.school_name, cte1.department_phone, cte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cte2.area_stddev, cte2.DLC_NAME FROM cte1 LEFT JOIN cte2 ON cte1.dlc_key = cte2.DLC_KEY ORDER BY cte1.department, cte1.grade_type, cte2.area_stddev DESC

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE isd.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required' AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME), RollupResults AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(max_enrollment_variance) AS total_variance, SUM(max_enrollment_stddev) AS total_stddev FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT SUM(max_enrollment_variance) IS NULL), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(total_sum) + STDDEV(total_sum) FROM (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_sum FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l2 JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t2 ON l2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT GROUP BY l2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS dept_totals) AND l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18') SELECT rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, rr.total_variance, rr.total_stddev, c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS library_faculty, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS tip_faculty FROM RollupResults AS rr JOIN inner_cte2 AS c ON rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l ON c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY rr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, rr.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, c.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.total_enrolled, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH MathFallSubjects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS checks: Eligibility: Term must have at least one subject with IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM='Y' (checked via EXISTS on EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE).
Eligibility: Term must not be cancelled (TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR <> 'C').
Measure Scope: Subjects from Mathematics department (DEPARTMENT_CODE='18') offered in that term.
Grain: One row per term, aggregating over all matching subject rows for that term.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS RANGE,
  VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS VARIANCE,
  STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
  AND t.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR <> 'C'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED f
    WHERE f.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
      AND f.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
  )
GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION

SELECT
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    MAX(co.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(co.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range,
    VARIANCE(co.TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance,
    STDDEV(co.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
INNER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED co
    ON at.TERM_CODE = co.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
WHERE at.TERM_STATUS <> 'Cancelled'
    AND co.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
HAVING EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED fall
    WHERE fall.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
        AND fall.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 1
        AND fall.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'
)
